title: "worked_example"

```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```
```{r}
install.packages("maps")
```


```{r}
bird_breeding_sites <- read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(bird_breeding_sites)
```

```{r}
colnames(bird_breeding_sites)
```
```{r}
glimpse(bird_breeding_sites)
```
```{r}
print(nrow(bird_breeding_sites))
print(ncol(bird_breeding_sites))
print(dim(bird_breeding_sites))
```

```{r}
bird_migration_sites <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(head(bird_migration_sites))
```
```{r}
glimpse(bird_migration_sites)
```
```{r}
colnames(bird_migration_sites)
```
```{r}
bird_breeding_selected <- bird_breeding_sites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

gt(bird_breeding_selected)
```

```{r}
bird_migration_selected <- bird_migration_sites |> select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |> distinct() |> rename(Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude, Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude, Stopover_Longitude = pslon, Stopover_Latitude = pslat, Iberian_Longitude = iblon, Iberian_Latitutde = iblat, Westmost_Longitude = awestlon, Westmost_Latitude = awestlat)

gt(head(bird_migration_selected))
```


```{r}
bird_breeding_exc <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(bird_breeding_exc)
```
```{r}
bird_migration_exc <- bird_migration_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(bird_migration_exc)
```
